question:
Will there ever be a day when we can see the Re EX novels adapted into anime?

I'd also love to see a movie adaptation of The Dream Seen by the Lion King!
answer:
I'd like to see them too. (laughs)

Honestly, I never thought Memory Snow or The Frozen Bond would get OVA adaptations either, so when it comes to possibilities, you can say whatever you want and the sky's the limit. I really, really want to see them!
